description.value: Courtyard Coffee is a locally owned café in the heart of downtown Qualicum Beach, serving espresso drinks made with Tofino's Rhino Coffee House beans, teas, house-made soups and sandwiches, and fresh baked goods. On sunny days, an inviting outdoor courtyard provides a pleasant rest stop for travellers. The café also sells Rhino beans and Hydroflask travel mugs at retail.

address.value: 673 Memorial Ave, Qualicum Beach, BC V9K 1G9
